difficulty_reason: The algorithm extracts the skeletal decomposition without scanning the full value. The author combines marked-term rewriting with exact marked-size step counting, variable-occurrence pointers, amortized absorption accounting and constant-time recognition of unmarked subtrees. The complexity parameter is the skeleton size itself; this is the main skeleton extraction algorithm, distinct from exponential strategy separation and machine simulation.
